title: Symbols scanned during the read sweep
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $E$ inject the symbols of $\Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e$ embed the binary alphabet into $\Gamma$. For a binary input $x$, a configuration $c$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$, a state $q$, and a valid counter $j<N+1$, the symbol scanned on each work tape $i$ in the read-sweep configuration at counter $j$ is the entry at offset $j$ in the block code of the symbol scanned on tape $i$ by $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is an embedding of symbols and blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits
$c$ is a configuration on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$
replaced:
For a counter $j \le N$, the work-tape symbols scanned by the read-sweep configuration
of a source configuration $c$ at counter $j$ are, on each tape $i$, the entry at offset
$j$ of the code of the symbol scanned by $c$ on tape $i$.
